handback.title: Finding and checking tests follows the test settings
handback.summary: Dokima finds, checks and times tests by the repo's test settings, not its own fixed values.
handback.feature: A repo's test folder, pattern, tag, commands and docstring rules decide how Dokima finds and checks tests. Two stories take turns on shared files.

stories.title: Tests are found and tagged by the test settings
stories.user_story: A repo's test tag, folder and run command decide which tests Dokima finds, links and runs.
stories.context: `dokima/checks.py` holds `PROVES`, `TEST_DEF` (top-level `def test_*` only), `NOT_TEXT` (still lists `dokima/roles/`) and `MANUAL_FIX` (folder `tests`). `dokima/planner.py` imports `PROVES` and `TEST_DEF` for `test_functions()`, whose block logic and `unsummarized()`/`unnumbered()` walk top-level nodes only, so class methods need them too. `problems()` hardcodes `tests/`; `main_with_tests()` lays `tests`; `passing_today()` runs `sys.executable -m pytest`. `dokima/defaults.yaml` already holds every setting (`tests.*`, `text_only.not_text` without `dokima/roles/`); read them with `dokima.settings.read()`.

acceptance_criteria.text: Which call links a test to its criterion is read from the test tag setting.
Dokima finds tests written as methods of a test class.
Dokima finds tests written as async functions.
Dokima finds tests indented under another block.
Changes to Dokima's prompt folder no longer stop the text-only shortcut.
The folders that stop the text-only shortcut come from settings.
The manual-fix check runs the tests in the test folder setting.
The planner's check refuses files outside the test folder setting.
acceptance_criteria.words: outside tests/; the planner may only write tests

acceptance_criteria.text: The planner's check lays the branch's test folder, from settings, over main.
acceptance_criteria.words: Lays main + branch `tests/` into a temp dir

acceptance_criteria.text: The check that new tests fail today runs each with the run-one command setting.
acceptance_criteria.words: New tests must fail today: pytest per test

stories.title: Planner's test limits and docstrings follow settings
stories.user_story: A repo's time limit, test file pattern and docstring rules decide what the planner's check accepts.
stories.context: `dokima/planner.py`: `NEW_TEST_TIMEOUT` (60 s) in `passing_today()`; `main()` picks test files with `startswith("tests/") and endswith(".py")`; `DOCSTRING_CAP` (15) in `docstring_caps()`; `unsummarized()` and `unnumbered()` require docstrings. Settings `tests.new_test_timeout_s`, `tests.dir`, `tests.file_pattern`, `style.docstrings`, `style.docstring_cap` are in `dokima/defaults.yaml`; null cap means off. Waits on story 1, which changes the same file.

acceptance_criteria.text: The check that new tests fail today stops a test after the time limit setting.
The planner's test files are found by the test folder and file pattern settings.
Turning docstrings off in settings stops the planner's check requiring them.
The planner's test docstring cap comes from settings.
An empty planner test docstring cap turns that cap off.
